terra.problem: 'False promises' is narrower than false oaths, which can also be false statements made while calling on God's name. Explain 'swearing' as making an oath using God's name, since a child might understand it only as using bad words.
Make the disagreement clearer: some understand the command as about oaths made in God's name, while others also include speaking of Him without respect.
